template_reserve_declaration.source: SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

parameters.name: nmii.rlc_phosphorylated_fraction

raw_declaration.source: active (RLC-phosphorylated) fraction — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). WHICH READING THE BUILD TAKES (nmii-life lane, 2026-09-21, after three rows were found to claim one quantity): this row is HEAD COMPETENCE and nothing else — cell/bonds.kinetic_owners gives a crossbridge relation to only this fraction of heads, and the built OBJECT count does not depend on it. The clause that stood here until today — the one asserting that this row fixed the assembled-minifilament fraction, quoted verbatim as the sentinel _ASSEMBLY_CLAIM in cell/nmii_molecules.py and deliberately NOT repeated in this file, so that restoring it here is what trips the refusal — is the reading the build does NOT take: nmii.areal_density (SOURCED, Nie 2015) already counts ASSEMBLED minifilaments and nmii.assembly_rate/nmii.disassembly_rate already fix the assembled fraction at ka/(ka+kd) = 0.5, so applying this row to the object count as well would reduce one population twice and would declare one fraction to be both 0.3 and 0.5. transforms.name: Soluble concentration to integer count
transforms.units: c:uM; Vg:um^3; u:uM per monomer/unit; N:count
qualifications: No fluid.cytosol_water_fraction multiplier in this route.
For buffers and CP, count unit means represented protein equivalents.
Count rounding is half-up here, unlike Python round used for motor object counts.

transforms.name: Finite soluble buffer partition
transforms.formula: T=Gtotal-Gfree; solve sum_i B_i*a/(Kd_i+a)=T; bound_i=B_i*a/(Kd_i+a). Round total/free and buffer counts first; bound_total=Ntotal-Nfree; PFN bound count is clamped to [max(0,bound_total-NT), min(bound_total,NP)]; thymosin bound is the remainder.
transforms.units: All concentration terms and auxiliary a:uM; integer inventories:counts
qualifications: Requires 0<=Gfree<=Gtotal and total-free<=sum B.
a is an auxiliary allocation activity, explicitly not imposed Gfree or an equilibrium assertion.
Initial soluble actin species are ATP-labelled; existing polymer is separate.

transforms.name: Available capper before and after end preparation
qualifications: Conditional finite chemistry path.
Legacy retired route k_cap_on*c_CP is not a finite inventory and refuses normal use by default.

transforms.name: Cofilin capacity versus cut coefficient
transforms.formula: N_cofilin=c_cofilin*602.214*Vg*f_water; P_served=sum(rest_contour_f/delta_f over reserve-served families); decoration_ceiling=N_cofilin/P_served; cut_coefficient=severing_rate*decorated_fraction.
transforms.units: N/P:counts; decoration_ceiling:dimensionless; cut coefficient:1/(um*s) as declared by the inspected function
qualifications: Ceiling is infinity if no protomers; decorated fraction separately constrained to [0,1].
The ceiling arithmetic does not round N into a dynamically consumed protein pool.
No binding isotherm or concentration-to-occupancy inference is established.

transforms.name: Cortical Arp2/3 pool
transforms.formula: r=R-sagitta-erm.r0-h/2; sagitta=a_mesh^2/(6R); Vs=4*pi*r^2*h; Vsw=f_water*Vs; Vw=f_water*Vg; u_bath=1/(602.214076*Vw); N_Arp=floor(c_Arp*602.214076*Vsw+0.5); activity_Arp=Vw/Vsw; c_realized=N_Arp*u_bath*activity_Arp.
transforms.units: R,r,h:um; volume:um^3; c:uM; N:intact-complex count; activity:dimensionless
qualifications: Thin-shell nominal geometry, not an exact wrinkled-shell integral.
For positive site count, per-site coefficient=k_b0*602.214076*Vsw/n_sites; total propensity=k_b0*N_free*n_free_sites/n_sites.
This makes the per-complex versus per-NPF source mismatch visible; no conversion is invented.

transforms.name: Assembled versus allocated NMII objects
transforms.formula: Na=int(round(rho*4*pi*r^2)); if object_life off: Ntot=Na; else ratio=kd/ka if ka>0 else 0; pa=1/(1+ratio); Ntot=int(round(Na/pa)); Ndormant=Ntot-Na.
qualifications: Finite nonnegative rates required; ka=0,kd>0 refused; ka=kd=0 yields ratio0 and pa1 in build arithmetic.
For ka+kd>0, pa=ka/(ka+kd); exact two-state transition uses exp(-(ka+kd)*dt).
Python round supplies ties-to-even integer rounding; these are template-derived counts, not observed abundance.

transforms.name: Structural versus competent motor heads
transforms.formula: N_heads=2*H*Ntot; per isoform owner range j: N_comp_j=int(round(f_RLC*2*H*N_j)); selected owner IDs drawn uniformly without replacement.
transforms.units: H:head nodes per pole; N_heads and N_comp:head counts
qualifications: Includes allocated dormant objects. Active competent heads require intersection with alive-object mask; actin-bound/force-bearing heads require further state observations.
Metadata n_heads_competent=int(round(f_RLC*N_heads)) need not equal the sum of separately rounded isoform selections.
A structural two-headed-molecule conversion is an extra model/measurement assumption.

transforms.name: Allocated isoform share versus initial live share
transforms.formula: NA=int(round(f_A*Ntot)); NB=Ntot-NA; IIA labels original indices i<NA; initially alive iff i<Na. Therefore NA_alive=min(NA,Na); NB_alive=max(0,Na-NA); fA_alive=min(NA,Na)/Na for Na>0.
qualifications: Exact integer consequence of the inspected prefix logic, not an empirical relation.

For ka=kd>0 with life enabled, Ntot=2Na; condition f_A=0.5 implies NA=Na and all initially live objects are IIA despite 50% total allocation. This is symbolic bookkeeping, not a simulated specimen or parameter recommendation.
When f_A=1, all allocated/live objects are IIA. No IIC or mixed-object heavy-chain mapping exists here.

transforms.name: Linear nuclear ratio and reference sphere
transforms.formula: R_from_volume=(3V/(4*pi))^(1/3); Rn=q*R. Only under matching concentric spheres: Vn/Vcell=q^3 and Vn/Vcytoplasm=q^3/(1-q^3).
qualifications: Actual pool conversion reads built surface volume0.
The radius-from-volume relation is the declared source transformation, not a newly inspected primary assay.
Cohort means and nonlinear transformations cannot be freely interchanged.

transforms.name: Cytoplasmic polymer census and contour
transforms.formula: rin=q*R+gap; rout=r-h/2-gap; Vband=(4*pi/3)*(rout^3-rin^3); Lrequested=c_F*602.214/370*Vband; Nfil=int(round(Lrequested/contour)); nseg=int(round(contour/seg)); arc_step=contour/nseg.
transforms.units: c_F:uM monomer equivalents; Vband:um^3; L/contour/seg:um; 370:subunits/um; Nfil:filaments
qualifications: Geometric annulus concentration convention, no water multiplier in this census.
Need rout>rin and at least one filament; at least 3 nodes per arc.
Chord-summed/mapped/prepared rest lengths may differ from nominal contour; optional whole-rise preparation rounds realized rest length to monomer_rise units.
Polymer inventory is independent of declared soluble Gtotal and is not silently subtracted from it.

growth_volume.meaning: Geometric membrane minus envelope surface volume; free actin concentration is configured.

growth_unit.meaning: Growth receives one-monomer concentration unit without a cytosol water-fraction multiplier.

unit_gate.meaning: Finite ordered-unit chemistry is called only when unit_chemistry_enabled is nonzero.

pool_census.meaning: Rounded soluble counts, total versus free buffers, CP and separate polymer inventory metadata.

pool_inventory.meaning: Separate actin, profilin, thymosin, capper and formin species inventories.

buffer_partition.meaning: Auxiliary competitive-binding activity conserves separately imposed total/free; not an equilibrium claim.

end_binding.meaning: End preparation can debit free regulator counts after soluble-pool initialization.

retired_cp.meaning: Retired two-state path refuses normal use; its concentration-times-association coefficient is a distinct historical route.

cofilin_ceiling.meaning: Concentration supports a one-cofilin-per-protomer decoration ceiling, not an occupancy fit.

cofilin_coefficient.meaning: Only reserve-served growing families enter the denominator; concentration checks capacity while rate times decorated fraction sets coefficient.

cofilin_protomers.meaning: Built rest contours, live end slots and family-specific rises produce the supplied protomer count.

shell.meaning: Nominal mid-shell radius, mesh sagitta correction and thin-shell geometric volume.

bath_geometry.meaning: Relation bath uses cytosol water volume and cortical-shell water volume.

arp_bath.meaning: Initial free complex count and volume-ratio activity reconstruct the cortical concentration.

arp_inventory.meaning: Each branch junction reserves one complex, returned by debranching.

arp_rate.meaning: Per-free-complex world propensity, site coefficient and finite free-site qualification.

arp_switch.meaning: Sites require all three rows and a positive reserve fraction.

arp_constant.meaning: 602.214076 concentration-to-count constant in the relation bath.

motor_count.meaning: Smooth mid-shell area sets assembled objects; life arithmetic creates total allocated objects; split uses that total.

motor_initial_state.meaning: Isoform and initial alive classifications both use prefixes of allocated object indices.

motor_heads.meaning: Two H-head poles per allocated object; head nodes are distinct from backbone nodes and arm subdivisions.

motor_ranges.meaning: Isoform owner ranges, total head and dormant counts, life rates and aggregate competent-head metadata.

motor_competence.meaning: Input is a validated fraction of heads competent to enter the cycle.

motor_reservoir.meaning: kd/ka reservoir arithmetic; zero and nonfinite-rate boundaries. Older reservoir-only prose precedes the later object-life implementation.

motor_population.meaning: Object-life switch; assembled/total arithmetic and conflicting assembled-fraction source-text refusal.

motor_split.meaning: Round(f times total objects), with IIB as the remainder; no IIC or mixed-head composition assignment.

motor_owners.meaning: Competence sampled and rounded per isoform owner range, including allocated dormant heads; this is not a bound-head census.

object_life_definition.meaning: Per-whole-object present/parked transitions and exact two-state probabilities, inspected as text only.

nuclear_radius.meaning: Linear nucleus-to-cell radius ratio, not area or volume ratio.

membrane_geometry.meaning: Radius drives membrane surface construction; area and volume references depend on geometric options.

under_membrane.meaning: Wrinkled membrane and envelope maps move constructed coordinates.

cytoplasmic_arcs.meaning: Geometric annulus, polymer concentration-to-length-to-filament census, then mapped arcs.

arc_discretization.meaning: Arc contour sets angular span; round(contour/seg) sets node intervals.

quantization.meaning: Optional explicit preparation changes rest lengths to integer monomer rises; does not change declared input or node positions.
